description: This Java class, PdfService, provides functionality to generate PDF documents for clients and contracts in the application. It includes methods to create PDF files with client lists and contract details using the iText library, integrating data from entities like Client, Contract, Company, and their associated repositories.

classes.name: PdfService
classes.description: A Spring Service component responsible for generating PDF documents for clients and contracts using the iText library. It includes methods for creating PDF listings of clients and detailed contract documents, handling file creation and formatting.

methods.name: printClientList
methods.description: Generates a PDF file listing the provided clients with specific details in a table format.

methods.name: makeTablePdf
methods.description: Creates a PDF document with a table representing the provided list of data rows.

methods.name: printContract
methods.description: Creates a PDF file containing the details of a given contract, including client info and company info.
